title: Pointwise reflections assemble to coherent adjunctions for full inclusions
statement: Use quasicategories, coherent functors, transformations, full subcategories and mapping spaces from [def-cbc-enhanced-diagrams-cones], and canonical mapping-space composition from [lem-coef-infinity-mapping-composition]. Work in a fixed containing universe. Let $\mathcal C$ be a quasicategory and $i:\mathcal D\hookrightarrow\mathcal C$ the inclusion of a full subcategory. Suppose that every $x\in\mathcal C$ admits an edge $u_x:x\to i(d_x)$ with $d_x\in\mathcal D$, such that precomposition induces an equivalence $\operatorname{Map}_{\mathcal C}(i(d_x),i(d))\to\operatorname{Map}_{\mathcal C}(x,i(d))$ for every $d\in\mathcal D$. Then there exist a coherent functor $P:\mathcal C\to\mathcal D$ and coherent transformations $a:\mathrm{id}_{\mathcal C}\to iP$, $b:Pi\to\mathrm{id}_{\mathcal D}$ satisfying the triangle identities up to homotopy in the corresponding functor quasicategories. Every component $a_x$ has the stated universal precomposition property. The dual assertion holds: if every $x$ admits $v_x:i(d_x)\to x$ inducing equivalences $\operatorname{Map}_{\mathcal C}(i(d),i(d_x))\to\operatorname{Map}_{\mathcal C}(i(d),x)$ for all $d\in\mathcal D$, then there are $B:\mathcal C\to\mathcal D$, $c:iB\to\mathrm{id}_{\mathcal C}$ and $e:\mathrm{id}_{\mathcal D}\to Bi$ with coherent triangle homotopies, and every $c_x$ has this universal postcomposition property. No compatibility of the initially supplied objectwise witnesses is assumed.
